author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: These parsers read Suricata EVE records, sent to syslog and on to the data collector. Alert records go to NIDS, dns records to DNS and flow records to Netflow, and other event types stay generic.
notes:
Setup:
- Send EVE to syslog (eve-log type: syslog, identity suricata).

Field mapping:
- alert records go to NIDS, dns to DNS and flow to Netflow; other event types stay in generic.

Made up in the samples:
- Samples follow the EVE format page with made-up values.

Testing:
- Each child, combined with the parent into one parser, passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13.
- On 2026-10-14 each child also passed Run Test in a lab tenant as a separate parser under its parent.

Known gaps:
- The tenant's built-in suricata_generic parser matches the same lines and normalizes nothing; the engine picks one parser per line, and in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13 it took the alert lines in 9 of 11 Run Tests and the flow lines in 5 of 11.
- Expect some lines to keep the built-in mapping.
